data.name: Moazzam
data.gender_notes: Moazzam is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'azamah' meaning 'glory' or 'honour'. In Islamic tradition, it is also the name of a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). The name Moazzam carries the meaning “Glory, Honour” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Moazzam usually hope their child will grow to embody glory, honour and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Notes a person's nobility and greatness in God's eyes.
data.etymology: Moazzam belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Glory, Honour.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Moazzam total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
